scope: Browser owner-session recovery; no provider/model coding acceptance claim

observed.failure: Browser view session is no longer active
observed.cause: Open tab retained a view session belonging to the previous web owner after a managed tray update

change.trigger: Exact native HTTP401 detail identifying a missing owner session
change.recovery: Single connection attempt restores the saved workspace and conversation through existing same-origin HttpOnly session enrollment
change.draft: Kept in the current DOM; text entered during recovery is not overwritten
change.replay: Failed requests, sends and mutations are never retried automatically
change.security: Explicit revocation and provider-key failures do not trigger this recovery; no keys or cookies exposed to JavaScript

regressions: Revocation/provider401 do not masquerade as owner restart
Draft retained without any session mutation
validation.live_browser: Reconnected through browser controls, selected profile/model and history restored, user's go draft restored and left unsent
validation.automatic_live_handoff: Not newly forced solely for this test; automatic recovery tested with HTTP/DOM fixtures
